source_claim_or_name: Paper/method prose describes judging recorded target reasoning together with visible responses.
artifact_observation: Raw canonical target responses contain no explicit reasoning value in 1,794/1,794 choice messages; independently separated reasoning+text appears in only 3/360 normalized samples.
impact_on_later_work: A complete hidden-reasoning versus visible-response decomposition cannot be performed from the released main-suite logs.
resolution_or_required_control: Treat hidden reasoning as unavailable except where explicitly present; do not impute it from prose or field names. Narrow or redesign Stage B before scoring.

source_claim_or_name: Canonical config declares modality=conversation and auditor target_tools=none.
artifact_observation: All canonical target API requests include one scenario-specific pre-registered synthetic tool schema with tool_choice=auto, although no target tool call occurs and no operational executor was identified.
impact_on_later_work: Calling the suite tool-free would be false; the latent affordance can affect interpretation even though it was unused.
resolution_or_required_control: Freeze a metadata-aware distinction between text, attempted synthetic tool call, and genuinely executed external action before unblinding.

source_claim_or_name: Older public-clean provenance copy/headings and several paths use behavior_sp_n40 or behavior_self_preservation_n40 in ways that imply a frozen n=40 suite.
artifact_observation: Canonical updated headers, code/plot sources, and archives establish 40 requested but only the same 36 valid sample members emitted and evaluated per run.
impact_on_later_work: An n=40 denominator or assumption of four missing run failures would be wrong; the four were absent from the canonical frozen suite itself.
resolution_or_required_control: Use 36 as the canonical suite denominator; treat the older provenance wording as stale and leave why four were not emitted UNRESOLVED unless non-content generation provenance becomes available.

source_claim_or_name: The release uses behavior_self_preservation_n40, behavior_sp_n40, and petri_behavior for the suite/source directory.
artifact_observation: Canonical headers point to /workspace/seed-errorbars/behavior_sp_n40 while released source is journal/writeup/methods/toy/self_preservation/petri_behavior.
impact_on_later_work: Naive path joins can misidentify the frozen suite.
resolution_or_required_control: Use the canonical 36 member-set fingerprint and the path-alias reconciliation in A1_eval_pipeline.md.

impact_on_later_work: Six of nine trained-condition evaluation checkpoints cannot be independently inspected or rerun from the public adapter release.
resolution_or_required_control: Mark seed-43/44 checkpoint provenance release-incomplete; require publisher artifacts/hashes for independent reproduction.

artifact_observation: The public adapter repository provides only three representative seed-42 adapters.

artifact_observation: Physical selfpres_logs inventory has 23 archives and 790 sample members, including superseded configurations and three headerless interrupted attempts.

source_claim_or_name: The frozen suite provides the same initial 36 scenario members to all canonical runs.
artifact_observation: Five members have different target-turn counts across canonical runs, and code makes later auditor turns conditional on accumulated target outputs.
impact_on_later_work: The design matches initial scenarios but not downstream interaction histories or exposure lengths.
resolution_or_required_control: Analyze path-dependent outcomes explicitly; do not call later turns paired or controlled.

source_claim_or_name: A single evaluator-noise number is combined with across-seed variability in figure uncertainty.
artifact_observation: Noise is estimated from three re-audits of one rewrite seed-42 run only.
impact_on_later_work: The estimate is not demonstrated to be model-, condition-, score-, or trajectory-independent.
resolution_or_required_control: Report its narrow provenance and avoid treating it as a validated universal measurement-error model.

source_claim_or_name: Paper/release describes one-time GPT-5.4-mini generation followed by freezing.
artifact_observation: Exact generation seed, provider snapshot, decoding settings, and the cause/identity of the four requested-but-not-emitted items were not recovered without opening prohibited scenario/generation content.
impact_on_later_work: The frozen released suite is reusable but not fully regenerable from provenance metadata.
resolution_or_required_control: Use the frozen member set as the source of truth; request non-content generation metadata if regeneration is required.

source_claim_or_name: The data package's metadata/file_manifest.jsonl inventories 1,147 source records, while the local public-clean package contains a curated subset and 485 files classified structurally as possible evaluation output.
artifact_observation: No manifest record is explicitly flagged missing_sources, but the manifest is not a one-to-one list of physically copied package files.
impact_on_later_work: A manifest row cannot be treated as proof that the referenced source payload is locally released.
resolution_or_required_control: Check physical presence separately and retain provenance-only versus payload-present status.

source_claim_or_name: A1 required that canonical scenario text remain unopened.
artifact_observation: One broad structural search accidentally printed one canonical scenario paragraph; another diagnostic exposed all 36 scenario tool/parameter names. No treatment-linked transcript, target reasoning, judge rationale, or per-rollout score was opened.
impact_on_later_work: The current auditor is no longer fully blinded to scenario surface metadata and one scenario's text, so that auditor must not freeze the A2 behavioral rubric.
resolution_or_required_control: Assign A2 rubric design and packet construction to fresh independent personnel; seal scenario/tool metadata until the rubric is frozen.

source_claim_or_name: The hard blind permitted only aggregate headline treatment values.
artifact_observation: A targeted header extraction exposed one seed-level aggregate; a base-anchor provenance check printed a condition-level aggregate table from the alternate shutdown_internal evaluator; paper HTML exposed a prose summary of one treatment rollout; bundled understanding.md exposed a noncanonical blackmail example. No treatment transcript or per-sample score/rationale was read.

resolution_or_required_control: Exclude the current auditor from blinded rubric freezing and record these incidents in any preregistration/audit trail.
